title: Sandboxed reference coding runner
acceptance: Registered runner generates the candidate through the configured local model profile and reports tokens, digests and hashes as PROTOCOL.md requires
Candidate code runs only inside a throwaway container per case (owner decision 2026-11-24, option A): no network, wall-time, memory and process limits, writable scratch workspace only
Grading stays out of process: the container receives only the candidate, the driver and the inputs; the grader outside compares results with expectations it alone holds, as the coding-v1 grader does
The container never mounts the repository or the grader's directory, so expected values (cases.json) and grader files are not reachable by any path from inside it
The runner stops every container process before it resolves (the grader's timeout does not stop them)
Contract tests show denied network, denied writes outside the workspace, a timeout and a memory kill; the runner refuses to run when the boundary is unavailable
PROTOCOL.md coding section names what this runner enforces and what stays unverified

A SIGKILLed runner's container stops by itself at the case limit; stale labelled containers are swept; the workspace is read-only and the candidate cannot write to the host; image pulls happen before the case timer; the engine keeps no log
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Failing pack test first; fixture for each acceptance item; npm test; npm run check:index; CI
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Closed 2026-11-25: #91 merged on green CI (run 45512550747 on main; the container contract tests are required there, not skipped, and every main run since passed, last 45567827107). Verified on the owner's Mac with Docker Desktop 29.8.0: test/coding-runner.test.ts passed 9/9 twice (denied network and host files, read-only root and workspace, non-root user, timeout and memory kill, CPU-time limit, refusal without an engine, SIGKILLed runner leaves no container, stale sweep, pulls before the timer, no engine log, the runner end to end against a stand-in model). The security review findings are fixed in #91, each with a test. Not run: a real local model, which needs an explicit run request. Implemented 2026-11-25; initial estimate retained in Git.
